description: Exact scheduling-only surfaces authorized by OM-020. Every test, literal command, cold-install proof, timeout, and coverage floor remains unchanged.

rationale.tests/config/t1-t3.coverage.config.ts: Applies the same disjoint serialized cohort to the canonical merged-coverage command without changing its provider, source population, or thresholds.
rationale.vitest.config.ts: Applies the disjoint two-project partition to the literal pnpm vitest run entrypoint.
rationale.vitest.scheduler.ts: Owns the exact cohort and constructs the shared project partition once for ordinary and coverage configurations.

forbidden: any test body, assertion, or timeout change
any literal convergence argv or order change
any test or coverage population reduction
any coverage provider, include, exclude, or threshold change
any environment worker override, skip, shard, cache substitution, or proof reuse
